title: Screen
description: Root payload returned by GET /screens/{name}. Describes a complete SDUI screen

screenName.description: Identifier of this screen — matches the route name in the client registry (ADR-003)

schemaVersion.description: Schema major version used to build this payload (e.g. 'v1')

backBehavior.description: Declarative back-button behavior (ADR-003). Open string enum — clients ignore unknown values

components.description: Ordered list of top-level components to render
